2026-10-18 WIRE-FORMAT BUG (the real cause of the nested-chunk failures): the client's luau_load reads a per-proto feedback-vector section for bytecode version >= 11 (lvmload.cpp:734; BytecodeBuilder::getVersion() returns 11 because LBC_VERSION_TARGET == 11), but the vendored BytecodeBuilder wrote that section only behind FFlag::LuauEmitCallFeedback (off by default). The wire was therefore misaligned at every proto trailer: single-proto chunks still selected protos[0] and worked by accident, two-proto chunks executed the inner function (`local function f() return 7 end; return 1` returned 7), and `nest1` killed the loader. Fixed by writing the (empty) section unconditionally in the vendored BytecodeBuilder.cpp; this is serialization-only and does not change codegen.
